2608.13334.title: RippleMem: From Isolated Retrieval to Associative Recollection for Long-Term Agent Memory
2608.13334.paper_summary: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on external memory to support long-horizon reasoning and interaction. However, the main bottleneck is not simply storing past experience, but recovering the right set of evidence when relevant information is distributed across many interactions. Existing approaches struggle with this access problem. Full-context methods require noisy long-context search, flat retrieval often returns isolated and incomplete records, and graph-based memory systems can be expensive to construct while compressing rich event context. We introduce RippleMem, a long-term memory system that replaces one-shot retrieval with adaptive associative recollection. Inspired by cue-dependent episodic retrieval and associative completion, RippleMem stores interaction history as cue-rich episodic memory units and organizes them in an event-centric memory graph. Given a query, it first recalls relevant memory anchors through hybrid cues, then expands from these anchors along semantic and structural associations to recover missing supporting evidence. In this way, initially recalled memories serve not only as answer context, but also as cues for completing the evidence needed to answer. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that RippleMem achieves the best overall performance across evaluated settings, improving LLM-as-a-Judge accuracy by 3.95% on LoCoMo and up to 11.87% on LongMemEval-S, while reducing graph construction cost by about 30x.
2608.13334.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於的代理越來越依賴外部記憶來支持長期推理和互動。<lb/>然而，主要的瓶頸不僅僅是儲存過去的經驗，而是在相關信息分佈於許多互動中時，恢復正確的證據集。<lb/>現有的方法在這個訪問問題上掙扎。<lb/>全上下文方法需要嘈雜的長上下文搜索，平面檢索往往返回孤立且不完整的記錄，而基於圖的記憶系統在壓縮豐富事件上下文的同時可能構建成本高昂。<lb/>我們介紹 RippleMem，一種長期記憶系統，用自適應聯想回憶取代一次性檢索。<lb/>受提示依賴的情節檢索和聯想完成的啟發，RippleMem 將互動歷史存儲為提示豐富的情節記憶單元，並將它們組織在一個以事件為中心的記憶圖中。<lb/>給定一個查詢，它首先通過混合提示回憶相關的記憶錨點，然後沿著語義和結構聯繫從這些錨點擴展，以恢復缺失的支持證據。<lb/>這樣，最初回憶的記憶不僅作為答案上下文，還作為完成回答所需證據的提示。<lb/>在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上的實驗顯示，RippleMem 在評估的設置中實現了最佳的整體性能，在 LoCoMo 上提高了 LLM-as-a-Judge 的準確率 3.95%，在 LongMemEval-S 上提高了高達 11.87%，同時將圖構建成本降低了約 30 倍。
